# Ledgerly: close the books in days, not weeks

Ledgerly is the finance automation platform for mid-market companies. Reconcile bank feeds, automate accruals and close faster.

Start your 14-day free trial. Plans: Growth, Scale and Enterprise (SSO, audit logs, dedicated CSM).

Trusted by finance teams at Northwind Logistics, Contoso Retail and Fabrikam Health.

Ledgerly runs on AWS in the US and India regions.
